The company intends to raise up to HK$13.86 billion through the sale of 280 million shares at a set price range. This listing follows the company's previous private market valuation peak in 2022.

item.title: Conflict in Gaza and Israel
item.description: An Israeli air strike in Deir al-Balah, Gaza, resulted in at least one death among displaced Palestinians sheltering near al-Aqsa Hospital. The Israeli military stated the strike targeted two individuals identified as Hamas members involved in military planning. Reports also highlight broader concerns regarding the ongoing collapse of the healthcare system in the region.

item.title: Conflict in Gaza and Israel
item.description: Israeli forces conducted a strike in Deir al-Balah, Gaza, which resulted in at least one death and was characterized by the military as a targeted operation against Hamas members. Separately, reports indicate that Syrian and Israeli officials engaged in US-mediated talks in Jordan regarding regional tensions. These events occurred alongside ongoing reports of humanitarian and healthcare challenges within Gaza.

item.title: WNBA and Enes Kanter Freedom
item.description: Former NBA player Enes Kanter Freedom was removed from a WNBA game after an altercation with Chicago Sky guard Natasha Cloud. Following the incident, Cloud released a statement on social media advocating for the protection and inclusion of transgender individuals. Reports indicate that both Freedom and Royce White have declared for the 2027 WNBA Draft, though their eligibility status remains a subject of reporting.

item.title: Conflicts in the Middle East
item.description: An Israeli air strike occurred near al-Aqsa Hospital in Deir al-Balah, resulting in casualties, while the Israeli military identified the targets as Hamas militants. Separately, reports indicate that Syrian and Israeli officials held US-mediated meetings in Jordan to address regional tensions. These events highlight ongoing military activity in Gaza and diplomatic efforts concerning Israel's northern border.

item.title: Iran Sanctions and Tensions
item.description: The United States has announced an intensified economic pressure campaign against Iran, targeting its oil revenue and international trade partners. This follows ongoing conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran, which has contributed to global fuel price increases. Simultaneously, concerns regarding cyber activity linked to Iran have been raised in the context of critical infrastructure protection.

item.title: Ukraine Support and Conflict
item.description: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham is visiting Kyiv to participate in Ukraine's independence day events and lead a meeting of the 'coalition of the willing.' The visit occurs amidst ongoing Russian strikes and international discussions regarding air defense and military support for Ukraine. Concurrently, Russia has initiated a decree allowing state intervention in the management of critical infrastructure found to be poorly protected.

item.title: Enes Kanter Freedom WNBA Controversy
item.description: Enes Kanter Freedom was removed from a WNBA game between the Indiana Fever and Chicago Sky after a verbal confrontation with Chicago Sky guard Natasha Cloud. Freedom claims the incident started after he celebrated a basket, while reports indicate he was escorted out by security during the third quarter. The incident occurred amidst Freedom's public attempts to challenge WNBA eligibility policies.

item.title: US-Iran Sanctions and Tensions
item.description: The United States has announced a significant financial offensive against Iran, aiming to isolate the country's economy through new sanctions and pressure on international trading partners. While US officials describe this as a strategic effort to target Iran's revenue streams, reports indicate concurrent global increases in petrol prices and domestic economic strain within Iran. Concurrently, reports have emerged regarding cyber-activity linked to Iran and official warnings from the Iranian government regarding oil exports and shipping routes.

item.title: Wildfires and Environmental Disasters
item.description: Wildfires are currently impacting multiple regions, including Reno, Nevada, where a human-caused blaze has triggered widespread evacuations and caused injuries. Simultaneously, Serbia is receiving international assistance to manage fires in the Deliblatska Pescara reserve and the Stolovi mountains. A separate forest fire is also reported to be threatening residential areas in Ankara, Turkey.

item.title: Israel and Gaza Conflict
item.description: Israeli forces conducted a strike near al-Aqsa Hospital in Gaza, which the military stated targeted Hamas members. Separately, reports indicate that Syrian and Israeli officials engaged in US-mediated talks in Jordan regarding regional tensions. Additionally, US Ambassador Tom Barrack reaffirmed the current US recognition of Israeli sovereignty over the Golan Heights.

item.title: Iran Sanctions and Tensions
item.description: The United States has announced an expanded campaign of economic sanctions targeting Iran's oil revenue and global financial partners. item.title: Middle East Conflict and Iran
item.description: The US Treasury Secretary has announced a significant economic sanctions campaign against Iran intended to isolate the country financially. Simultaneously, reports indicate ongoing hostilities in Gaza and separate concerns regarding Iran-linked cyber activities affecting international infrastructure. item.title: Global Disaster and Outbreaks
item.description: This analysis covers five independent events: a cycling stage cancellation in France, an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a wildfire in Nevada, a typhoon in Asia, and a landfill collapse in Guinea. Each event is reported as occurring in disparate geographic locations with distinct impacts on local populations. No shared subjects or interconnected narratives are present across the provided reports.

item.title: Trump and US Politics
item.description: Trade negotiations between the U.S. and Canada have collapsed, resulting in the imposition of 50% tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian goods and planned retaliatory actions. Domestically, the Trump administration faces friction with some Republican lawmakers over beef import policies and internal party scrutiny regarding potential cooperation between Democratic leadership and administration figures. Additionally, President Trump commented on the series of assassination attempts directed at him during a media appearance.

item.title: Conflict in Gaza
item.description: An Israeli air strike occurred near al-Aqsa Hospital in Deir al-Balah, with the Israeli military confirming the operation targeted two individuals. Reports indicate the strike took place in an area hosting displaced persons, while military statements characterized the targets as combatants linked to Hamas. These reports occur alongside ongoing concerns regarding the status of the broader healthcare infrastructure in Gaza.

item.title: US-Iran Tensions and Sanctions
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced a new economic pressure campaign intended to isolate Iran by targeting its oil revenue and secondary trade partners. This announcement follows reports of ongoing conflict involving the US, Israel, and Iran, and coincides with claims from the Trump administration regarding the collapse of the Iranian economy. Meanwhile, Iran has reportedly threatened to restrict oil exports and shipping through the Strait of Hormuz in response to the continued conflict.

item.title: Guinea Landfill Collapse Disaster
item.description: A landfill landslide in Conakry, Guinea, resulted in at least 30 deaths following heavy overnight rains. Rescue operations were initiated in the area to locate survivors buried under the waste. The government had previously identified the site as a potential hazard prior to the collapse.

item.title: Conflict in Gaza
item.description: An Israeli air strike in Deir al-Balah, Gaza, resulted in casualties among civilians in a tent shelter according to reporting from Aljazeera. The Israeli military confirmed the strike, identifying the targets as members of Hamas's military wing involved in operations against Israel. The event occurs amidst ongoing reports of a severe healthcare crisis and territorial planning in the region.

item.title: US Iran Sanctions and Tensions
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has announced a significant economic pressure campaign intended to isolate Iran by targeting its oil revenue and international trade partners. This announcement coincides with a broader six-month conflict involving the United States, Israel, and Iran, which has influenced global fuel prices and Iranian currency markets. Both sides have issued warnings, with the US threatening secondary penalties for trade partners and Iran warning against passage through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Brain-eating amoeba death
item.description: An eight-year-old girl from Ruston, Louisiana, died on Saturday following an infection health officials attribute to a brain-eating amoeba. The family confirmed the death on Facebook, noting that the brain injuries were too severe for recovery. Reports indicate the child had recently swum in a lake prior to the onset of the fatal condition.

item.title: Conflict in Gaza and Israel
item.description: An Israeli air strike near al-Aqsa Hospital in Deir al-Balah resulted in casualties, with the Israeli military asserting the targets were Hamas-affiliated militants. Separately, Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani engaged in US-mediated talks with an Israeli delegation in Jordan to discuss de-escalation. Meanwhile, reports continue to describe the severe degradation of the healthcare infrastructure within Gaza's displacement camps.

item.title: Iran Sanctions and Tensions
item.description: The United States and Israel continue their six-month-long military conflict with Iran, with the U.S. administration announcing plans for further economic sanctions. Meanwhile, global petrol prices have seen increases in many countries, and Pakistan is pursuing diplomatic mediation efforts in Tehran. U.S. officials and Iranian authorities have both exchanged warnings regarding the future trajectory of the conflict and international economic cooperation.
